h1: When do you need a street opening or trench permit from Newton Engineering?
title: Newton Street Opening Permits: Excavation in the Public Way
description: Learn why work in a Newton street or public right-of-way needs City coordination and when Massachusetts trench rules may apply.
short_answer: Work that opens a Newton street or public right-of-way should be reviewed by Newton Engineering before excavation begins. Massachusetts also regulates construction-related trenches and requires compliance with state trench-safety rules. The exact Newton application, insurance, bond, and restoration requirements depend on the type and location of work.

facts.text: Newton Engineering reviews site work and public-way projects, including utility and street-related work.
Massachusetts trench regulations allow permitting authorities to stop trench work when required permits or public-safety protections are missing.

qa.q: Does a Newton Engineering permit replace state trench requirements?
qa.a: No. A local street or Engineering permit does not replace applicable Massachusetts trench-safety requirements.
